title: Evaluating Bayesian deep learning for robust biomedical time-series classification under distribution shift: A sleep scoring case study
abstract: arXiv:2610.35484v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In biomedical time-series classification, machine learning models often suffer from deteriorating accuracy and calibration due to distribution shift. We investigate to what degree Bayesian-inspired deep learning improves robustness through Bayesian model averaging (BMA). Using rodent sleep scoring as a case study, we evaluate BMA under distribution shifts in genotype, laboratory, and species. We systematically compare nine approximate inference methods spanning single- and multi-basin approaches across two neural network backbones on in-distribution (ID) data and five out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. In our results, multi-basin methods perform best, outperforming baselines and single-basin methods. Compared with point estimates, BMA generally improves OOD accuracy and calibration across both architectures, while yielding only modest ID gains. translated_title: 评估贝叶斯深度学习在分布偏移下实现鲁棒生物医学时间序列分类的效果：以睡眠分期为案例研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.35484v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在生物医学时间序列分类任务中，机器学习模型常因分布偏移而导致准确率和校准性能下降。我们研究了受贝叶斯启发的深度学习在多大程度上能够通过贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）来提升鲁棒性。以啮齿动物睡眠分期作为案例研究，我们在基因型、实验室和物种三个层面的分布偏移下对BMA进行了评估。我们系统地比较了九种近似推断方法（涵盖单盆地和多盆地方法），并在两种神经网络骨干架构上，分别在分布内（ID）数据集和五个分布外（OOD）数据集上进行测试。结果显示，多盆地方法表现最佳，优于基线方法和单盆地方法。与点估计相比，BMA在两种架构上通常都能提升分布外准确率和校准性能，而在分布内数据上仅带来有限的改进。此外，BMA还常常能改善选择性预测以及分布外和伪影检测，但有趣的是……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究以啮齿动物睡眠分期为案例，系统比较了九种贝叶斯近似推断方法在基因型、实验室和物种分布偏移下的表现，发现多盆地方法结合贝叶斯模型平均能显著提升生物医学时间序列分类的分布外准确率、校准性能以及分布外和伪影检测能力。
en_tdlr: Using rodent sleep scoring as a case study, this work systematically compares nine Bayesian approximate inference methods under genotype, laboratory, and species distribution shifts, showing that multi-basin Bayesian model averaging substantially improves out-of-distribution accuracy, calibration, and OOD/artifact detection in biomedical time-series classification.
